description: Move files or folders into a .shieldfive-mcp-trash directory inside their own root and on their own volume, with a manifest recording where each came from. A symlink is trashed itself, never what it points to. NOTHING IS DELETED and no disk space is freed — the bytes stay on the same volume until you empty that directory yourself. Without confirm: true this only reports the plan.

paths.description: Absolute paths to move into the trash, at most 1,000.

items.description: Absolute path. Must resolve inside a configured root; relative paths are refused.

plan_token.description: The plan_token this tool returned when called without confirm. Required with confirm: true, single use, and only valid while the plan still matches the tree.

name: trash_local
title: Move files to this server’s trash
